an4.168:1.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
an4.168:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca :
an4.168:2.7: imā kho āvuso sāriputta catasso paṭipadā.
an4.168:2.8: imāsaṃ kho āvuso catassannaṃ paṭipadānaṃ katamaṃ te paṭipadaṃ āgamma anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti?
an4.168:3.3: dukkhāpaṭipadā dandhābhiññā, dukkhāpaṭipadā khippābhiññā, sukhāpaṭipadā dandhābhiññā, sukhāpaṭipadā khippābhiññā.
an4.168:3.5: imāsaṃ kho āvuso catassannaṃ paṭipadānaṃ yāyaṃ paṭipadā sukhā khippābhiññā. imaṃ me paṭipadaṃ āgamma anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
